panels.visual: Gan gives Earmack water, assessing her injuries - scrapes, cuts, bruises, the damage of hard riding and harder circumstances. Nothing life-threatening. The girl drinks desperately, water running down her chin. Her rope-burned wrists tell a story of captivity.
panels.narration: Whatever she had fled from, she expected it to follow.

panels.visual: Hours later, inside Hind's great tent. The company is gathered close - Hind seated in command, the heroes ranged around her. Earmack sits on cushions, still trembling but able to speak. Gan kneels beside her to interpret. The incense-thick air is charged with tension.
panels.narration: After a few hours, with food in her belly, she was able to speak.

panels.visual: Wide shot of Hind's tent showing the full company gathered to hear Earmack's tale. Firelight and lamplight illuminate their faces - Eskil's helm, Bansi's sharp features, Giovanni's troubled expression, Lueduo still pale from his vision. All eyes are on the battered girl who survived what killed her companions.
